adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` compute the calendar id like:

```ts
const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId
  ? externalCalendarId
  : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;
```

When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the else branch), the `.find()` predicate compares `cal.externalId` to that same falsy `externalCalendarId`, so it will never match a real calendar id and returns `undefined`. This makes the fallback effectively broken and will drive the request to use an undefined calendar id (or whatever later defaulting logic does, e.g. `primary`), rather than selecting an intended destination calendar from `event.destinationCalendar`. That is a concrete correctness issue introduced by this diff.
